claim: Try it with sample data in one click
sandbox: fresh browser context; click the landing action; assert seeded due and draft explanations

claim: Demo data is not saved to your real work
sandbox: fresh browser context; create a demo explanation; assert it is absent from the real library

claim: Reset demo and Start for real clear only demo data
where: demo banner, privacy page, README, demo documentation
sandbox: fresh browser context entered at /?demo=1; create real and demo records; reset and exit; assert samples reseed and real work survives

claim: Completed explanations return after seven days
sandbox: fresh browser context entered at /?demo=1; create a sample explanation; answer all four prompts; finish; assert 4/4 and the exact seven-day date

claim: Each explanation uses four distinct prompts: mechanism, boundary, example, and counterexample
sandbox: fresh browser context entered at /?demo=1; open a sample explanation; select each named prompt and assert its distinct question heading

where: landing limits, library data tools, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context entered at /?demo=1; choose Start for real; create a real draft; download JSON; parse and assert its topic

claim: Import an Explanation Lab JSON backup
sandbox: fresh browser context entered at /?demo=1; choose Start for real; attach a valid JSON backup; assert its explanation appears in the library

claim: Invalid imports make no changes to saved explanations
sandbox: fresh browser context entered at /?demo=1; choose Start for real; attach a backup containing one valid record and one invalid date; assert neither record is saved and the library remains usable after reload

claim: Matching imported IDs ask whether to replace or skip saved explanations
sandbox: fresh browser context entered at /?demo=1; choose Start for real; import a matching ID; dismiss and accept the explicit decision; assert skip preserves it and replace changes it

claim: JSON exports include text and local audio notes
sandbox: fresh browser context entered at /?demo=1; record an audio note in real work; export and inspect its data URL; clear storage; import and assert the audio control returns

claim: The app does not send explanations or audio to a server
sandbox: fresh browser context entered at /?demo=1; edit text and record audio while recording all requests; assert no cross-origin requests

claim: The app does not grade or generate explanations or sync devices
sandbox: fresh browser context entered at /?demo=1; inspect the stated limits and assert the flow makes no cross-origin request

claim: The app uses no analytics, advertising, or third-party scripts
sandbox: fresh browser context entered at /?demo=1; visit the privacy page while recording requests; assert every request is same-origin
fresh browser context entered at /?demo=1; choose Start for real; assert the editable practice form opens without sign-in or payment

sandbox: fresh browser context entered at /?demo=1; create real work; delete the real IndexedDB database; reload and assert the record is gone
